tab.enroll_login: login failed: check the user name and password
tab.secret_bad: Could not save: check the value
tab.poll_d: How often to refresh the server list
tab.key_confirm: Sure? Servers must be connected again
tab.connect_copied: Command copied: paste it on the server (as root)
tab.connect_d: Copies the command that installs restricted access
tab.enroll_d: The administrator password is needed once: it is not stored and never reaches the logs. A user «serp» is created on the server with a key that can only run allowed scripts.
tab.add_server_d: A server that is not in the panel: add it by address
tab.err_name: Name: 1 to 60 characters, no control characters
tab.err_host: Address: a domain or IP, no spaces or characters like / ; $
tab.err_user: User: letters, digits, _ and -, up to 32 characters, starts with a letter
tab.err_dup: A server with this address and port is already added
tab.err_broken: servers.toml is damaged: fix it by hand
tab.added_ok: Server added. Access is not installed yet.
tab.remove_title: Remove the server from the widget?
tab.remove_d: The server disappears from the widget only. Nothing is changed on the server itself.
tab.remove_both: Also remove access from the server
tab.remove_both_d: Additionally the key, serp-run, the allowed scripts and the sudoers entry are deleted from the server (the serp user stays). Needs the administrator password, used once and never stored.
tab.unenrolled_ok: done: access removed from the server
tab.consent_title: What will be installed on the server
tab.consent_1: A user serp without a password: it can be logged into only with this widget's key.
tab.consent_2: The key is restricted: it opens no shell, it only runs the serp-run program.
tab.consent_3: serp-run runs only an allowed list of scripts: {list}.
tab.consent_4: One sudoers entry: serp may use sudo to run only serp-root (the scripts above as root), nothing else.
tab.consent_5: The administrator password is used once for the installation. It is never stored and never reaches the logs.
